Physical Plan (Ray Runner)
═════════════════════
Project: cat, total
↑
Group-By Aggregate (global)
sum(total)
↑
RayShuffle: Hash
num_partitions = 2
by = col(cat)
↑
Group-By Aggregate (local)
sum(bonus → total)
↑
Project: bonus, cat
↑
UDF: py_udf(val) → bonus
↑
Project: val, cat
↑
ScanTaskSource
Num Scan Tasks = 2
Pushdowns: projection + filter ✅
